headline: Roblox Faces Shareholder Lawsuit Over Age Verification Disclosures
summary: A shareholder has filed suit against Roblox's CEO and directors, alleging the company failed to properly disclose that implementing age checks caused a significant decline in daily active users.
why: Roblox's valuation depends heavily on daily active user metrics and engagement across younger demographics.

impacts.name: Roblox Corporation
impacts.why: Legal scrutiny and reported drops in daily active users threaten platform monetization expectations.
